scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 12 boards of six live Deity Science (Online) games (civvis-20261105T172506Z, 121129Z, 111305Z, 093803Z, 095229Z, 173830Z), each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of a turn where a wounded sea hull stood with full moves in unowned water, unmoved for at least 30 turns. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at 2fb4cb881 with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with wounded-ship-sails-on. The claim ('sails on') is journaled in 8/12 on arms and 0/12 off arms, on exactly the eight boards whose off arm journals 'holds position to heal'; orders differ in 7/12, and in the eighth (172506Z t100) the explorer found no move that turn. The four that do not fire are not this gene's case on one frame: 095229Z (two boards) stands at 72 hp with danger 34, journalling 'holds rather than strike', a different path the gene rightly leaves alone; 111305Z (two boards) is at 53 hp, above ROTATE_HP, so only the live decider's in-memory recovering set holds it and a one-shot replay reads it as fit.
